mapper.sql: SELECT u.id,u.workspace_id,u.login_id,u.password_hash,u.display_name,r.role_code,w.kind workspace_kind FROM app_user u JOIN user_role r ON r.user_id=u.id JOIN workspace w ON w.id=u.workspace_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace WHERE id=#{workspaceId} AND (kind='NORMAL' OR expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
WHERE w.id=#{workspaceId} AND r.role_code='STAFF' AND u.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY u.id
